t: Robust replacement pilot drill bit for Bosch Powerchange adaptor. Tip design provides greater accuracy, higher speed and durability. Can be used for drilling centre holes in preparation for stable work with other holesaws. Suitable for use with wood, drywall, plastics, metal, non-ferrous metal and stainless steel. Designed to be used with Bosch Pro holesaws.
b: Heat-Treated & Hardened High Speed Steel Construction
Suitable for Wood, Drywall, Plastic, Metal, Non-Ferrous Metal & Stainless Steel
